integrity: Same-model analytic reconstruction with a bounded exact-symbolic consistency checker; originality not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only single nontranslational odd zonal Legendre modes at width two in three dimensions; the all-constant-width optimal-volume question and mixtures remain open. The spectral volume formula is previously known; new claims concern sharp all-degree convexity, mode ranking, and meridional curvature degeneracy.
title: Sharp convexity and volume hierarchy of one-mode zonal constant-width solids
